responsibility: This machine-description helper file defines reusable mode iterators, code iterators, and attributes shared throughout the NDS32 .md patterns. It groups scalar, doubleword, floating, vector, and shift/arithmetic RTL forms into named iterators and provides attribute substitutions such as opcode fragments, size suffixes, element widths, and signed/unsigned markers, allowing the main instruction descriptions to be written compactly while consistently covering related NDS32 instruction families.
